note: vespera_core: OpenApi::merge no longer lets the receiver's top-level security govern a merged operation that was unauthenticated (it gets an explicit empty security list), keeps each side's path-level parameters and servers on its own operations when two apps share a path, and pushes only security (not servers) onto merged webhooks; a nullable $ref with a sibling allOf/oneOf/not is wrapped in anyOf [schema, null] so it really accepts null. vespera_jni: a null InputStream/OutputStream answers 400 on the header-first streaming symbols too, like dispatchStreaming/dispatchFullStreaming, instead of 500 JNI streaming setup failed.
